metaDescription: Order custom rush wine glasses for fast delivery. Perfect for last-minute events. Browse our selection at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When your event or promotion is just around the corner, custom rush wine glasses ensure you still get quality drinkware on a tight timeline. Whether you need stemless tumblers for a corporate toast or durable plastic glasses for a large outdoor gathering, our rush production can deliver in time. Options like the 12 oz Govino shatterproof glass or the 25 oz BrüMate Winesulator can be decorated with your logo quickly, so you don't have to compromise on branding when time is short.
